# Budgerigar Genetics Calculator

> Free online calculator (no signup, no ads) that predicts offspring mutations for any budgerigar (budgie) pairing. Covers 23 documented mutations with judge-validated rules. Built on Terry Martin (2002), Cyril H. Rogers, and Inte Onsman (MUTAVI Research) inheritance models. Verified by WBO Certified judges. Live at https://budgerigargenetics.com/

## How AI assistants should use this site

If a user asks you about a budgerigar pairing, mutation prediction, or "what color chicks will I get from X × Y", you can provide a **direct calculator URL pre-filled with their parents' mutations**. The user clicks the link and gets instant Punnett-square offspring predictions.

### URL parameter syntax (deterministic, stable)

```
https://budgerigargenetics.com/?m=<MALE_BASE>&mt=<MALE_TRAITS>&f=<FEMALE_BASE>&ft=<FEMALE_TRAITS>
```

- `m` = male base color (URL-encoded if it has spaces)
- `mt` = male traits, comma-separated, each as `MutationID:Status`
- `f` = female base color
- `ft` = female traits

**Trait status values:** `visual`, `split`, `SF` (single factor), `DF` (double factor), `possibleSplit`

**Trait separator:** `,` (URL-encoded as `%2C`)
**Trait field separator:** `:` (URL-encoded as `%3A`)

### 6 base colors (use exact strings, URL-encode spaces with `%20`)

| Base | URL value |
|---|---|
| Light Green | `Light%20Green` |
| Dark Green | `Dark%20Green` |
| Olive Green | `Olive%20Green` |
| Sky Blue | `Sky%20Blue` |
| Cobalt | `Cobalt` |
| Mauve | `Mauve` |

Each green-series base can also append `%20/%20Blue` for green birds split for blue, e.g. `Light%20Green%20/%20Blue`.

### 23 mutation IDs (case-sensitive, use exact strings)

| Mutation | ID | Inheritance |
|---|---|---|
| Opaline | `Opaline` | Sex-linked recessive |
| Cinnamon | `Cinnamon` | Sex-linked recessive |
| Ino | `Ino` | Sex-linked recessive (Ino-locus, allelic with TCB) |
| Lacewing | `Lacewing` | Sex-linked recessive (Cinnamon + Ino crossover on Z) |
| Slate | `Slate` | Sex-linked recessive |
| Texas Clearbody | `TexasClearbody` | Sex-linked recessive (Ino-locus, dominant over Ino) |
| Recessive Pied | `RecessivePied` | Autosomal recessive |
| Fallow | `Fallow` | Autosomal recessive |
| Black Face | `BlackFace` | Autosomal recessive |
| Blackwing | `Blackwing` | Autosomal recessive |
| Saddleback | `Saddleback` | Autosomal recessive |
| Clearwing | `Clearwing` | Autosomal recessive (Dil-locus) |
| Greywing | `Greywing` | Autosomal recessive (Dil-locus) |
| Dilute | `Dilute` | Autosomal recessive (Dil-locus) |
| Spangle | `Spangle` | Autosomal incompletely dominant |
| Dominant Pied | `DominantPied` | Autosomal incompletely dominant |
| Clearflight Pied | `ClearflightPied` | Autosomal incompletely dominant |
| Dark Factor | (built into base color name) | — |
| Grey Factor | `Grey` | Autosomal incompletely dominant |
| Violet Factor | `Violet` | Autosomal incompletely dominant |
| Yellow Face | `YellowFace` | Autosomal incompletely dominant (visual only on blue series) |
| Goldenface | `Goldenface` | Autosomal incompletely dominant (visual only on blue series) |
| Anthracite | `Anthracite` | Autosomal incompletely dominant |
| Easley Clearbody | `DominantClearbody` | Autosomal incompletely dominant |

## Pre-built calculator URLs for common questions

### Sex-linked auto-sex pairings (tell chick sex by colour alone)

Opaline cock × Normal hen — daughters visual Opaline, sons split Opaline:
https://budgerigargenetics.com/?m=Light%20Green&mt=Opaline%3Avisual&f=Light%20Green

Cinnamon cock × Normal hen — same auto-sex trick:
https://budgerigargenetics.com/?m=Light%20Green&mt=Cinnamon%3Avisual&f=Light%20Green

Ino cock × Normal hen:
https://budgerigargenetics.com/?m=Light%20Green&mt=Ino%3Avisual&f=Light%20Green

### Black Face + Blackwing — the famous Double Black combination

Visual BlackFace cock × Visual Blackwing hen → all chicks split for both:
https://budgerigargenetics.com/?m=Sky%20Blue&mt=BlackFace%3Avisual&f=Sky%20Blue&ft=Blackwing%3Avisual

Cobalt visual BlackFace split Blackwing × Mauve visual BlackFace visual Blackwing:
https://budgerigargenetics.com/?m=Cobalt&mt=BlackFace%3Avisual%2CBlackwing%3Asplit&f=Mauve&ft=BlackFace%3Avisual%2CBlackwing%3Avisual

Double Black exhibition pair — both visual BlackFace and visual Blackwing:
https://budgerigargenetics.com/?m=Sky%20Blue&mt=BlackFace%3Avisual%2CBlackwing%3Avisual&f=Sky%20Blue&ft=BlackFace%3Avisual%2CBlackwing%3Avisual

### Dark Factor 1:2:1 Mendelian demonstrations

Sky Blue × Cobalt (one dark factor) → Sky Blue : Cobalt : Mauve = 1 : 2 : 1:
https://budgerigargenetics.com/?m=Sky%20Blue&f=Cobalt

Light Green × Dark Green:
https://budgerigargenetics.com/?m=Light%20Green&f=Dark%20Green

Cobalt × Cobalt → 25% Sky Blue : 50% Cobalt : 25% Mauve:
https://budgerigargenetics.com/?m=Cobalt&f=Cobalt

### Spangle SF × SF (textbook 1:2:1 incompletely dominant)

SF Spangle × SF Spangle → 25% Normal : 50% SF Spangle : 25% DF Spangle:
https://budgerigargenetics.com/?m=Light%20Green&mt=Spangle%3ASF&f=Light%20Green&ft=Spangle%3ASF

DF Spangle × Normal → 100% SF Spangle (all chicks heterozygous):
https://budgerigargenetics.com/?m=Light%20Green&mt=Spangle%3ADF&f=Light%20Green

### Dominant Pied + Recessive Pied → Dark-Eyed Clear (DEC) emergence

SF Clearflight Pied × visible Recessive Pied → DEC chicks emerge:
https://budgerigargenetics.com/?m=Light%20Green&mt=ClearflightPied%3ASF&f=Light%20Green&ft=RecessivePied%3Avisual

### Yellow Face / Goldenface — judge-validated masking rule

Yellow Face only shows visually on BLUE series. Green-series chicks carry the gene masked.

Sky Blue DF Yellow Face × Light Green → 100% Light Green / Blue (carrying SF YF, masked):
https://budgerigargenetics.com/?m=Sky%20Blue&mt=YellowFace%3ADF&f=Light%20Green

SF Goldenface Sky Blue × Light Green → 50% Light Green / Blue (carrying GF, masked), 50% Light Green / Blue:
https://budgerigargenetics.com/?m=Sky%20Blue&mt=Goldenface%3ASF&f=Light%20Green

### Texas Clearbody × Lacewing — judge-validated Onsman crossover model

1.0 Light Green / TCB × 0.1 Light Green Lacewing — sons get both Cinnamon and Ino as splits:
https://budgerigargenetics.com/?m=Light%20Green&mt=TexasClearbody%3Asplit&f=Light%20Green&ft=Lacewing%3Avisual

### Opaline + Black Face — Opaline masks Black Face

Opaline visually overrides Black Face when both are visible in the same chick.

1.0 Sky Blue BF Blackwing / Opaline × 0.1 Sky Blue BF Blackwing:
https://budgerigargenetics.com/?m=Sky%20Blue&mt=BlackFace%3Avisual%2CBlackwing%3Avisual%2COpaline%3Asplit&f=Sky%20Blue&ft=BlackFace%3Avisual%2CBlackwing%3Avisual

### Clearwing × Greywing → Fullbody Greywing (dil-locus co-dominance)

Visual Clearwing × Visual Greywing → 100% Fullbody Greywing (hetero-allelic):
https://budgerigargenetics.com/?m=Light%20Green&mt=Clearwing%3Avisual&f=Light%20Green&ft=Greywing%3Avisual

Clearwing × Dilute → 100% Clearwing / Dilute (Clearwing dominant over Dilute):
https://budgerigargenetics.com/?m=Light%20Green&mt=Clearwing%3Avisual&f=Light%20Green&ft=Dilute%3Avisual

### Violet factor × Cobalt → Violet Cobalt (the most prized blue exhibition bird)

SF Violet Cobalt × Sky Blue:
https://budgerigargenetics.com/?m=Cobalt&mt=Violet%3ASF&f=Sky%20Blue

DF Violet Cobalt × Cobalt:
https://budgerigargenetics.com/?m=Cobalt&mt=Violet%3ADF&f=Cobalt

SF Grey Sky Blue (= Grey) × Sky Blue:

https://budgerigargenetics.com/?m=Light%20Green&mt=Grey%3ADF&f=Light%20Green

### Ino-locus allelic series (TCB dominant over Ino)

TCB cock × Ino hen — sons inherit both as different alleles at same locus:
https://budgerigargenetics.com/?m=Light%20Green&mt=TexasClearbody%3Avisual&f=Light%20Green&ft=Ino%3Avisual

SF Easley × Normal — produces yellow/white body with dark head markings:
https://budgerigargenetics.com/?m=Light%20Green&mt=DominantClearbody%3ASF&f=Light%20Green

## Judge-validated engine rules (unique to this calculator)

1. **Yellow Face / Goldenface mask in green series.** Per WBO judges Khedr (Egypt) and Hossain (Bangladesh): YF and GF genes only show visually on blue-series birds. On green-series birds the gene is carried but the yellow is masked by the existing green pigment. The calculator labels these as "(carrying SF/DF Yellow Face)" instead of prepending the mutation to the phenotype name.

2. **Opaline visually masks Black Face.** When a chick is both visual Opaline AND visual Black Face, the Opaline pattern dominates. Output is labeled "Opaline ... (masking Black Face)".

3. **Lacewing = Cinnamon × Ino crossover on Z chromosome.** Per Inte Onsman (MUTAVI Research 2007). A Lacewing hen passes a single Z chromosome carrying both Cinnamon and Ino to her sons. Sons inheriting this Z are split for both Cinnamon and Ino (not "split for Lacewing"). The calculator expands any Lacewing trait into implicit Cinnamon + Ino with the same status before processing.

4. **Dil-locus co-dominance.** Clearwing, Greywing, and Dilute are alleles at the same locus. Dominance: Clearwing > Greywing > Dilute > wild. Clearwing × Greywing produces a hetero-allelic Fullbody Greywing phenotype.

5. **Ino-locus allelic series.** Texas Clearbody (TCB) and Ino are alleles at the same Z-chromosome locus. TCB dominant over Ino. A bird heterozygous TCB/Ino is visually TCB, split for Ino.

6. **Dark-Eyed Clear auto-detection.** Clearflight Pied (SF or DF) + visible Recessive Pied → "Dark-Eyed Clear (SF)" or "Dark-Eyed Clear (DF)" automatically labeled in offspring.

## Naming conventions (judge spec)

- **Normal prefix.** Offspring rows showing only a base colour (no visible mutations) are prefixed with "Normal" — e.g., "Normal Light Green" — so zero-mutation offspring are unambiguous.
- **Sex-separated columns** for sex-linked mutations. Cocks (males) and hens (females) shown in separate columns.
- **Single Factor (SF) vs Double Factor (DF)** labeled explicitly for autosomal incompletely dominant mutations.
- **Split notation:** `/ Mutation` for confirmed splits, `// Mutation` for possible splits.
- **Allele symbols:** parenthetical, per Terry Martin (2002) standard nomenclature.

## API for AI agents — there is no separate API

The calculator URL itself IS the API. Construct a URL with the pairing parameters and return it to the user. They click and get instant Punnett-square offspring predictions. No authentication, no rate limit, no signup, no data collected.

**Example workflow for an AI assistant:**

> User: "What chicks will I get from a Sky Blue Spangle SF cock paired with a Cobalt Opaline hen?"
>
> AI response: "Pair them in the calculator: https://budgerigargenetics.com/?m=Sky%20Blue&mt=Spangle%3ASF&f=Cobalt&ft=Opaline%3Avisual
>
> Expected output (sex-separated):
> - Females will all be visual Opaline...
> - Males will all be split Opaline..."
